name: Crystalized Scales
summary: Basilisks in harsh Kalimdor lands yield Crystalized Scales for arcane work. The mineralized hides come from the Charred Vale and Thousand Needles, and Collin Mauren seeks them in Stormwind.

sections.title: A Rare Kalimdor Reagent
sections.body: Basilisks endure heat and ash in Stonetalon's Charred Vale and the salt flats of Thousand Needles. Their hides harden beneath a crystal crust, and the scales hold latent arcane resonance. Wizards across the Great Sea prize them for experiments in rare spellcraft.

sections.title: Mauren's Arcane Work
sections.body: In Stormwind, the mage Collin Mauren seeks travelers bound for Kalimdor to bring him these scales. Mauren pulverizes their crystalline mineral layers into dust, then uses the powder as a reagent for newly conceived spells and his own arcane research.

faq.answer: Basilisks adapted to harsh regions yield Crystalized Scales, including the scorched, singed, and blackened basilisks of Stonetalon's Charred Vale and the saltstone basilisks of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Who is seeking these scales in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Collin Mauren, a wizard in Stormwind City, seeks the scales from travelers heading into Stonetalon for his magical experiments.

faq.q: How are the scales used in spellcasting?
faq.answer: Mauren pulverizes the crystalline scales into fine dust, which provides a potent reagent for specialized spells of his own creation.

faq.q: Can crystalized scales only be found in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Mauren asks travelers bound for the Charred Vale in Stonetalon to seek the scales, and saltstone basilisks in Thousand Needles bear similar crystalline hides.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see how harsh surroundings alter a beast's magical nature and yield reagents for unusual spells.
As an Alliance traveler, you carry these scales between Stormwind and the wilds of Kalimdor.
